items.description: The diplomatic fallout comes as Ethiopian forces battle rebel fighters across its northern region.

items.title: Iraq celebrates departure of international coalition and last US troops
items.description: Baghdad declared October 1 a day of celebration, ending 23 years of American military presence since the March 2003 invasion. Meanwhile, US President Donald Trump hailed a 'victory' for both countries.

items.title: Cloaked in anonymity, Israeli soldiers describe mass civilian killings in 'NAZA'
items.description: NAZA is an acronym for nezek agavi, Hebrew for "collateral damage." It refers to the number of civilian casualties the Israeli military deems acceptable. The documentary is made by Israeli filmmakers.

items.title: Malaysia: UN agency urges safeguards after refugees returned to Myanmar
items.description: The UN refugee agency, UNHCR, has voiced concern over Malaysia’s decision to return 1,476 people to Myanmar amid an ongoing civil war and a dire human rights and humanitarian situation.
